messages.content: I caught a problem with the Phoenix rental. The confirmation is for a neighborhood branch, and it closes before my flight lands Monday. Move it to the airport facility without changing the flights or hotel.

The airport location has midsize cars available. Moving the reservation there changes the rental total from $238 to $276.40 because of airport taxes and facility fees. Pickup will be at the Rental Car Center, which is open 24 hours. Should I make the change and then verify the early Thursday return process?
Yes. Make the change. My American flight lands at 11:28 a.m. Monday, so confirm how I get there and whether the reservation will be held if baggage takes a while.

The reservation is now moved to the Phoenix Sky Harbor Rental Car Center. From the terminal, follow signs to the PHX Sky Train and take it to the Rental Car Center; trains run continuously. Your pickup is listed for 12:15 p.m., and the agency will hold the car through 2:15 p.m. under the confirmed flight number.
Now check Thursday. I leave the Holiday Inn at 6:15 for the 9:05 flight. Can I return the car before the counter opens, and how much time should I allow for the train back to the terminal?

Vehicle returns operate 24 hours even though the staffed counter opens later. Follow airport signs to Rental Car Return, record the fuel level and mileage, leave the contract in the drop box, and keep the fuel receipt. Allow about 10 minutes to inspect and return the car, then 10-15 minutes for the Sky Train and terminal walk. A 6:15 a.m. hotel departure should put you at the terminal around 7:05 a.m. under normal traffic.
Update the estimate too. Use $34 for fuel instead of the old figure, and show me the complete itinerary. Flag the authorization issue if the airport fees push it over.

With the airport rental at $276.40 and fuel at $34, the projected trip total is $1,459.40, which is $28.40 above the $1,431 authorization. The flights and hotel remain unchanged. I have not altered either reservation.
That is fine. Give me the final schedule and make the excess clear so I can submit the increase today.

Final Phoenix itinerary: Monday, April 6, American nonstop SFO-PHX at 9:15 a.m., arriving 11:28 a.m.; Sky Train to the Rental Car Center for a 12:15 p.m. midsize pickup; then drive to Holiday Inn & Suites Goodyear for the April 6-9 stay. Tuesday and Wednesday, allow 14-18 minutes from the hotel to the audit site. Thursday, April 9, depart the hotel at 6:15 a.m., complete the 24-hour rental return and drop-box procedure, take the Sky Train to the terminal, and board the 9:05 a.m. American nonstop to SFO, arriving 11:12 a.m. Projected total: $1,459.40, including $276.40 for the airport rental and $34 for fuel. An authorization increase of $28.40 is required.
